testcase.name: a card shows kept finds' identifications as species chips, each species once, withheld finds left out
the album's find badge marks a photo on a saved find, and not one attached only to a draft find
a card's stats row shows each kept type's figure with its unit, in kilometres
a card whose kept track is not in the loaded list shows no thumbnail, beside one that is
the month header stays pinned at the top while that month's cards scroll under it
a draft card in the drafts list draws the path saved for its kept track that is gone, through the Journal tab
a card whose kept track is in the loaded list with two or more points shows its thumbnail
only a kept track draws, a withheld track in the list gives no thumbnail
a card keeping two tracks shows their total distance and duration labelled with the count
a card whose kept track is gone from the loaded list draws the path saved for it
a card's track stat follows the user's distance unit
a card keeping two tracks, one of them not loaded, still draws the one it has
the hero is the earliest attached photo still in the gallery, skipping an earlier deleted one, on top of the card
entries sit under month headers, newest month first
a saved path of one point gives no thumbnail, as a live track of one point does not
a withheld track's saved path gives no thumbnail and is not asked for
a card keeping two tracks draws them in one thumbnail
singular stats read 1 find, 1 waypoint, 1 offline map, and a type with nothing kept shows no stat
a saved path is asked for only the entries whose kept track is not in the loaded list
an entry with nothing kept and nothing written collapses and says so
touching a collapsed row at several points opens that entry
an entry with no attached photo has no hero, beside one that has
a card keeps its thumbnail when its track is deleted from the loaded list
a card shows the day numeral and weekday, the first line as its title, and no ISO date
touching a card at several points opens that entry
an entry with no photo, no text and no track collapses to one short row with its day and stats
in compact portrait the cards are one full-width column, one card per row
a Recorded Tracks row shows its thumbnail with two or more points and none with fewer
a card whose kept track has fewer than two points shows no thumbnail, beside one that has two
a wordless, trackless entry is a card when its photo exists and collapses when every photo is gone
